name: angel_umbrella
about: Angel Next Door story Short: Amane finds a girl sitting alone in the rain and gives her his umbrella without a second thought - she is the school's 'angel', Mahiru. The drop opens what that umbrella started (her smiles, their meals, holding hands) and ends on him telling her he likes her natural smile.
anime: The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten

story.why: if you sit out in the rain like this, people are gonna worry about you
you'll catch a cold - take this, I don't need it
an angel - that's what they call Mahiru Shiina

outro.why: you're so cute, it's a shame you can't always smile like that

title: He Gave His Umbrella To A Stranger, She Turned Out To Be The School ANGEL
hook: One rainy night Amane handed his umbrella to a girl sitting alone on a swing. She was Mahiru Shiina, the angel of his school - and his next-door neighbour.
